stemMd: No outdoor exhibit is insured unless it is secured overnight. Some outdoor exhibits are insured. Every insured exhibit has been valued by an assessor. Which must be true?

options.label: B
options.textMd: Some outdoor exhibits are both secured overnight and valued by an assessor.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Some insured outdoor exhibits are not secured overnight.

options.label: D
options.textMd: No indoor exhibit has been valued.

explanationMd: Use the explicitly existing insured outdoor exhibits as witnesses. Each must satisfy the security condition and, because it is insured, the valuation condition. No converse of either rule is needed.

distractorRationale.e: Security is necessary, not sufficient, for insurance.
distractorRationale.d: The premises do not exclude indoor valuations.
